// diagnostic E2823

Jet.BrowserCodeReachesServerResource

`{function}` runs in the page, but it reaches `{resource}`, which only the server has.

What

`{function}` runs in the page, but it reaches `{resource}`, which only the server has.

Why

Code in JS (pinned `#Target(JS)`, using the `Browser` effect, or called from code that is) runs in the page, and a database or a secret stays on the server, so the page can never reach it; it is reported where the page first reaches it.

Fix

Move the `{resource}` work into a method of a service marked `#App.SignedIn` or `#App.Public` and call it through `app.Remote`, or keep `{function}` out of the page.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.BrowserCodeReachesServerResource: Tests/UI/web_capability_boundary_browser_reaches_database.stderr.
